title: Text Tool
text:
Text Tool
    Create, save, fork, and combine five text segments from one persistent Gradio workspace.

title: Setup
text:
This site embeds a Gradio app hosted on Hugging Face Spaces.
The app stores saved drafts in a mounted Hugging Face Storage Bucket at /data. When run locally, it falls back to space/data/history.json.
Useful commands:
uv run python space/app.py
quarto render
quarto publish gh-pages --no-browser
